documents.text:
Alice is a university student.
She studies computer science.
If Alice studies hard, then she passes her exams.
Alice typically studies hard before exams.
When Alice is focused, she completes her assignments on time.
Alice sometimes gets distracted by social media.
She works part-time at the campus library.
Her assignments are due every Friday.
Alice rarely studies late at night.
In her free time, Alice likes to play volleyball and board games with her friends. She is usually not competitive, unless she is playing on her Sunday volleyball league.

test-34.hypothesis: Alice studies a subject other than computer science.

test-35.hypothesis: Alice is never distracted while studying.

test-36.hypothesis: Alice frequently studies late at night.

test-37.hypothesis: Alice enjoys working at the library.

test-40.hypothesis: Alice completes her assignments on time every week.

test-42.hypothesis: Alice's volleyball league happens on Sundays.

test-43.hypothesis: There may be times where Alice plays board games.

test-44.hypothesis: Alice can be on her free time but not enjoying playing board games.

test-47.hypothesis: Alice does not have free time.
